query:
SELECT p.day AS "day!: i64" FROM posts p
               WHERE p.series_id = ?
               ORDER BY EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM media_attachments m
                            WHERE m.series_id = p.series_id AND m.day = p.day
                              AND m.media_missing = 0
                        ) DESC,
                        RANDOM()
               LIMIT 1
